Throwing Attack Skills are one of the Skill Types. All Throwing skills take time to attack which is influenced by Throwing Attack Speed and the skills base attack time.

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 2 List of Throwing Attack Skills

- 2.1 NPC

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Throwing Attack Damage

- Increased Throwing Attack Speed

### Affixes[]

- Increased Throwing Attack Damage
